alt: What a new member with no brand access sees: the welcome to the organization, a note that no project is shared with them yet, next steps, Check access again and their organization and role
_source: Local EF app (EF_APP=http://127.0.0.1:8010), demo organization 798, route /organization/no-brand-access, reached inside the app (a full page load of that URL is a 404 from Laravel; the BrandAccess middleware redirects there). The eval action swaps window.user for a fictional member (Jordan Kim, role editor) and pushes the route in the SPA so the page reads it. Neither button is clicked. Re-shoot: EF_APP=<local app> node tools/shots/shoot.cjs organization-no-brand-access

actions.eval: (async () => { Object.assign(window.user, { id: 9105, name: 'Jordan Kim', email: 'jordan@example.com', organization_role: 'editor', role: 'editor' }); const r = document.querySelector('#app').__vue_app__.config.globalProperties.$router; await r.push('/organization/no-brand-access'); })()
